title: QuickPLS 2.55 case-specific named evidence observations
description: Exact additive field schema for a trusted candidate driver report's named_evidence_observations array. The collector additionally requires each case_id to belong to the frozen 55-case matrix, derives the exact operation/assertion ID from the source index, requires expected and observed to be equal, and rejects artifact or source-pointer reuse.
x-quickpls-runtime-constraints: case_id must be one exact ID from validation/v255_named_evidence_index.json
operation must equal collector_contract.operation_by_group for that case
assertion.expected and assertion.observed must be non-null and deeply equal
screenshot must be a CRC-valid PNG below the current candidate evidence root
one source report pointer and one screenshot SHA-256 may support only one named case
